articleTitle: Comparison and Application of Logistic Regression and Support Vector Machine in Tax Forecasting
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As an indispensable part of economy and society, the proportion of enterprise tax planning in national finance is becoming increasingly important. With the development of economy and information technology, machine learning technology is more and more widely used in various fields, and it is often used to study tax forecasting. However, most of the machine learning methods are difficult to model efficiently because of the problem of tax data with few samples and multi dimensions. To solve this problem, this paper selects the open tax data set provided by an enterprise, and forecasts it based on logistics regression model and support vector machine regression model. We use the average absolute percentage error as the standard to measure the performance difference of the two models in this field. The results of this paper can help enterprise decision-makers to carry out more scientific and reasonable tax planning, and provide some decision-making reference for the national tax department.

articleTitle: A combination of Super-resolution and Deep Learning Approaches applied to Image Forgery Detection
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: There are a number of techniques used to create forgery images and with the case of copy-move or splicing techniques normally compatible resolutions of original and faked images are assumed in the detection. This would make the process of forgery images becoming monotony and not much challenges. In this paper, we propose an appropriate method to detect tampered images with the change in resolutions of the splicing areas that have been inserted within the images then a combination method of the superresolution approach and the deep learning technique would make an efficient method for image forgery detection. Specifically, we implement the CNN model namely VGG16 trained by the VGG network. We use the VGG16 model with 16 classes. With the test model mentioned above, the results were given with an accuracy of up to 94.64%.

articleTitle: Analysis of occupational stress and influencing factors of civil aviation pilots
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Objective to investigate the current status of job stress of pilots and related influencing factors. Methods Cluster sampling was used to select 656 pilots as respondents. The contents of the investigation included general data and occupational information. The job content questionnaire (JCQ) was used to measure work requirements independent imbalance type. Results 71.19% (467/656) of the 656 pilots had work requirements independent imbalance type of occupational stress. Univariate analysis showed that the factors of age, marital status, education level, personal habits (smoking/alcohol consumption), daily sleep time and professional title had various degrees of influence on the different factor scores of JCQ. However, only age, marital status, education level, daily sleep time and professional title showed influence on the JCQ total score(P<0.05). Logistic regression analysis showed that main influencing factors of JCQ stress included age, marital status, education level, personal habits (smoking/alcohol consumption), daily sleep time and length of service. Conclusion Pilots had higher occupational stress level. According to the different occupational nature and working environment the intervention should be carried out according to the specific factors affecting occupational stress of pilots.

articleTitle: Research on Optimization of Fresh Cold Chain Logistics Distribution Path Considering Road Impedance
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Under the condition of considering the road impedance, the mixed time window constraint is introduced to establish the optimal model of cold chain logistics distribution path of fresh food with the goal of minimum total distribution cost. Then a hybrid genetic-simulated annealing algorithm is designed, and the proposed model is solved in combination with the actual case. Through the analysis of the results obtained, it is found that the method proposed in this paper can enable enterprises to improve customer satisfaction while reducing distribution costs.

articleTitle: A Review on Application of Knowledge Graph in Cybersecurity
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the development of information technology and the increasing complexity cyber environment, the volume of data involved in cybersecurity is also increasing rapidly and the risks of cybersecurity are also increased. There is an urgent need to find correlation and attack patterns from fragmented and massive multi-source heterogeneous cyberspace related data. The construction of cyberspace security knowledge graph can build massive fragmented multi-source heterogeneous data into one module and conduct fine-grained deep association analysis. To provide further master the cyberspace security situation and auxiliary decision-making. In this paper, we summarizes the development of knowledge graph related technology and the application of knowledge graph in cyberspace.

articleTitle: Research on Application of Blockchain in Internationalization of China's Medical Tourism Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The rapid development of medical tourism has occupied a certain share in the international tourism market and Asian region has also become the main medical tourism reception market. However, the internationalization process of China's medical tourism industry is still relatively backward and it is inferior to the traditional power of medical tourism in Asia. With the development of the digital economy and the digital earth, China should seize the potential of blockchain digital technology to carry out technological innovations in the domestic medical tourism industry, create a new international product line for medical tourism, and highlight the encirclement of international medical tourism.

articleTitle: Research on location selection of pre-warehouse of fresh e-commerce retail enterprises under O2O mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on the characteristics of offline chain retail enterprises, this paper puts forward the model of "supermarket central warehouse + convenience store pre-warehouse", and takes the minimum construction cost and the highest customer satisfaction as the two constraints, establishes the corresponding mathematical model. Using the methods such as K-means algorithm and genetic algorithm, the supermarkets and convenience stores of group A in Dongcheng District of Beijing are taken as an example for case analysis.

articleTitle: Passenger Flow Forecast of Catering Business based on Autoregressive Integrated Moving Average and Smoothing Index Prediction Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As people’s living standards improve, more and more catering enterprises are trying to develop more reasonable business development by using machine learning methods for data mining. Through the prediction for restaurant patronage, the dining experience of customers can be improved, and at the same time, the restaurant industry can achieve more efficient operation. This paper proposes the use of ARIMA time series model and smoothed exponential prediction model algorithm for restaurant patronage prediction, and demonstrates the rationality and feasibility of the idea through experiments. It provides new ideas for applying machine learning techniques and achieving efficient operation in the restaurant industry.

articleTitle: Operational Safety Analysis and Improvement of Private Pilots from the Perspective of Transaction Cost Theory
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In order to adapt to the rapid growth of private flight activities brought by the great development of general aviation and improve the safe and efficient operation of private aviation activities, the characteristics of private flight and pilot was analyzed. Using basic research method of the transaction cost theory and taking the limited rationality and opportunism of human beings as the premise, this paper regarded the transfer and acquisition of the right to fly an civil aircraft between the authorities and pilots as a "transaction" and analyzed how to use civil aviation association to improve the safety operation of private pilot in uncertain environment of transaction. Suggestions for the associations’ management were made as well. The functions of civil aviation associations should include service function, bridge function, self-discipline function and industrial research and policy suggestion function. The modes between authorities and associations should be cooperation and mutual supporting. It showed that the associations would play an irreplaceable role between the authorities and pilots in the policy advocacy, formation of positive flight manner and regulations awareness, communication with private pilots and support for their safe operation. Vigorously developing civil aviation associations will help the authorities to better serve the development of general aviation.

articleTitle: Research on Mechanism of Rural E-commerce Promoting Collaborative Innovation of Agricultural Industrial Cluster
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper builds a theoretical framework of mechanism for rural e-commerce to promote the collaborative innovation of agricultural industry clusters from the accumulation of resources such as production factors after the development of rural e-commerce in agricultural industry, the overflow of knowledge, the reconstruction of relationship networks, and the creation of an innovative environment. Taking the characteristic agricultural industry of Mile in China as an example, the mechanism of rural e-commerce to promote collaborative innovation of agricultural industrial clusters was explored. A good agricultural industry foundation is the advantages and potential of developing e-commerce, and the development of rural e-commerce can better promote the integration of resource of agricultural industry clusters and enhancement of innovation capabilities.

articleTitle: A Comprehensive Research of Models Between Internet Development and China’s Economic Growth
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In this paper, we build growth model that this article research need. Using the index and the production function model estimates the rate of contribution for the Internet resource index to GDP growth, using GM (1, 2) model to evaluate the relationship of the index of GDP and Internet resources, using GM (1, 1) model forecast the index of Internet resources, so that people can more comprehensive understanding of the emergence and development of the Internet have make an important influence on China’s Economic Growth.

articleTitle: Research on the Application of Book Locating Technology in Library Shelving Management for Universities and Colleges
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Book shelving and locating is a highly useful book management method, which could shorten the book search time of readers and improve the efficiency of book management. Focusing on the application of book locating technology in the library shelving management of Wuhan University of Technology, this paper explores how different book locating methods bring convenience to the book management of library in universities and colleges. The practical experience reveals the improvement of reader satisfaction and management efficiency by selecting a suitable locating method for books in terms of management mode and circulation.

articleTitle: The realization of flow management technology in solving the air traffic congestion pre-perception and intelligent guidance in North China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: During the 13th Five-Year Plan period, the rapid growth of air traffic flow, so that the air traffic control industry is facing great pressure. The contradiction between flight flow support capability and airspace capacity is increasingly prominent, North China is under increasing pressure to secure flights. The existing air traffic control service as the core of the operation management mode is no longer competent. A relatively independent, professional and systematic flow management system covering all aspects of flight operation is an inevitable requirement to ensure the safe, orderly and efficient operation of large-scale air transport system. From the perspective of flow management system construction, this paper expounds the construction background, construction content and technical innovation direction of the project. Air traffic control departments make full use of new technologies, new equipment and new control means to continuously tap the control potential and improve the comprehensive support capacity of air traffic control through scientific methods.

articleTitle: The Application of Statistical Analysis in Financial Management
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: This paper first introduces the statistical analysis of related knowledge and the commonly-used methods of financial analysis. By using the centralized mode, the financial information of enterprises is centralized processed. Financial model uses the basic data statistics. As a whole, according to solid management, sectors,other companies, subsidiaries are passed data acquisition according to the plan, with the relevant valuable data as an independent unit in the chain, finally on the basis of return on net assets, with other financial index as input, to make data analysis model. Based on the statistical analysis method of SVM algorithm, this paper maps the statistical analysis into the design of enterprise financial efficiency and data core value, discusses the system architecture and various functional requirements, and designs and realizes the enterprise financial efficiency analysis system based on statistical analysis, which has good adaptability and expansion ability.

articleTitle: A study on the liberalization effect of air transport market between China and the Single Africa Air Transport Market
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The establishment of the Single African Air Transport Market is of great significance to the liberalization of international air transport market. Based on this background, this paper studies the effect of the liberalization of China and the Single African Air Transport Market by using the expanded gravity model. It is found that the relaxation of the clause of capacity, the fifth freedom traffic rights and code sharing can promote the development of the air transport market between China and the Single African Air Transport Market, which implies that the aviation authority can promote the bilateral cooperation between China and Africa by expanding the relevant air traffic rights.

articleTitle: Schedule Control of Alternator Trial Production
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: R&D production is complex and takes relatively a long time. This paper studies production schedule control for R&D production. The case study can provide a reference for similar companies to take schedule control of trail production for R&D.

articleTitle: Research on the Influencing Factors of the International Competitiveness of China’s Service Trade Based on Grey Correlation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on the data onto 2009-2018, this paper measures the international competitiveness of China’s service trade with the help of common trade performance evaluation indexes, constructs the evaluation index system of influencing factors of international competitiveness of service trade with the combination of industrial characteristics and improved "Diamond Model", and then uses the grey correlation analysis method to measure the correlation degree of different influencing factors. The results show that the competitiveness of China’s service trade shows a steady upward trend, but the import-export structure is unreasonable and the deficit is increasing year by year; the export volume of goods, the actual use of foreign capital and the global innovation index have a significant impact on the international competitiveness of China’s service trade. It is suggested to improving the international competitiveness of China’s service trade with the aspects of reducing trade barriers, expanding international market and optimizing industrial structure.

articleTitle: Network Information Technology Application Based on Blockchain
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As a new application model of distributed data storage, smart contract and other computer technologies in the Internet era, blockchain has been widely used in digital currency, payment and settlement, material supply chain, energy transaction, etc. It is essentially a decentralized database. Through its unique technical design and data management methods, it can support multi-party collaboration in different fields. Blockchain technology is a new research result in the field of encryption and security. It is closely related to network and information security, and can be used to solve some problems in this field, such as attack defense, data protection, privacy protection, identity authentication, crash recovery, etc. Security testing involves multiple subjects such as R&D manufacturers, evaluation agencies, operation and maintenance units, and system users. It just caters to the characteristics of blockchain multi-party participation, data sharing, and establishment of mutual trust mechanisms.

articleTitle: Application of BIM Technology throughout the Construction Project Lifecycle of Teaching Integrated Building
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Taking the teaching integrated building project as an example, BIM implementation throughout all stages of the construction process were discussed. This paper focuses on the construction of student activity center project, applies the BIM technology to assist the project management, and adopts software including Revit, Navisworks and Magicad to achieve comprehensive BIM application results, including the 3D site layout and simulation, collision check and optimization, visualized disclosure and sample planning, panoramic technology, BIM 5D management, and etc. The results show that collision inspection can effectively solve the conflict problem in design, and the advantage of 5D can be used to optimize the sign. In addition, in terms of construction, the optimal allocation of resources and the improvement of construction quality can be achieved through the simulation of construction scheme and construction schedule.

articleTitle: Resources Are Allocated in Different Types of PPP Projects Based on the Dea-Game Model in the Competitive Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Reasonable allocation of resources is the key to successful cooperation, especially under the premise of financial constraints. The public should allocate resources reasonably through APP to accelerate the project process and alleviate financial problems. The purpose of this paper is to evaluate the efficiency of various PPP projects to further improve the project efficiency and ease the financial pressure. A new effective model is proposed to evaluate various PPP projects by DEA method. The results show that the model can effectively evaluate the efficiency of PPP projects, which is conducive to easing the financial pressure and promoting the economic development.

articleTitle: Theoretical research based on "Internet+" in the management of power safety tools
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of my country's power infrastructure construction level, in various power production activities, the configuration and use management level of safety tools and appliances directly affect the personal and equipment safety of power companies. In addition to ensuring the safety of operations through efforts in production operations and construction safety management, the quality requirements, performance tests and standardized management of safety tools and equipment are also the most concerned issues for the majority of frontline employees. This article will focus on the safety management and control of power safety tools and appliances, strengthen basic management, dynamically track health, real-time warning of hidden dangers, standard reminders of detection tests, realize management intelligence, information and automation, and further implement "safety first, prevention as The principle of "main and comprehensive management" guarantees personal safety.

articleTitle: Research on the Dynamic Mechanism and Countermeasures of the Integration of Sichuan Liquor Culture Tourism Industry
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Based on a research experiment on a travel questionnaire survey, this article firstly finds out the problems in the integration of liquor culture tourism industry: lack of a strategic plan, nonintegrated organically, lack of relevant talents and publicity, poor connotation of liquor culture, superficial integration degree and simple integration mode. After then, it analyzes integration mechanism of Sichuan liquor industry and tourism industry from the three sides: the industry relevance, market convergence point, the integration path. Finally, the article gets the integration implementations: take liquor culture as the core and integrate tourism resources, carry out Eco-tourism and incorporate the production base of brewing materials into the tourism industry development system, excavating the connotation of liquor culture in depth, enriching the development of liquor culture tourism products, create a vary modes of integration.

articleTitle: A Dragon Analysis Model
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The three dragons in Game of Thrones have great power. Supposing the three fictional dragons were still alive, we build the DA model to analyze dragons. Firstly, we refer to Richards model—one of the most common model of creature size, to describe dragon’s body features in accordance with volume. Then in order to conduct fitting, we use the data of tyrannosaurus rex and the formula from another paper, which describes the relationship between femoral girth and body weight, finally we get the volume function. Secondly, when building the energy model, based on the energy budget equation, we decide to apply large bird’s energy model to our study and add the special activity energy to explain dragon’s ability to breath fire. Then we refer to the basal metabolic rate and active metabolic rate of super-large birds to calculate the energy of dragons. Finally, we get the calorie intake of dragons at different ages. Thirdly, for the characteristics, we assume that dragons can fly (even long distances), breath fire, and resist trauma. The mechanisms of flight and fire breathing are relative to energy metabolism. And we assume that dragon’s ability to resist trauma is related to the rate of cell proliferation. Then we build the cell growth model for this area’s research.

articleTitle: Quantitative Analysis and Coutnermeasures of Pilot Resignation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The development status and the resignation phenomenon of the pilot market in China are studied by elaborating origins of the phenomenon of pilot loss. On this basis, the causes behind pilot resignation related events were discussed. Meanwhile, the questionnaire survey method was adopted to conduct a classification analysis on the way to alleviate pilot resignation and guide the pilot team, and the possible main consideration factors of the current pilot resignation were classified, which mainly include the large influence of family life, the less humanistic care from company, and lack of personal career planning.

articleTitle: Architectural Design of Small and Medium Terminal-Taking Shennongjia Airport as an Example
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Starting from the design practice of Shennongjia airport terminal, from its configuration, design concept, process design and space organization, integrated design, sustainable design, etc., to explore the design logic of small and medium-sized terminal, and to explore the development trend of small and medium-sized terminal design from two aspects of cultural experience and space experience.

articleTitle: Analysis on the construction of long-term mechanism of school enterprise cooperation in the integration of industry and education
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The foundation of the current undergraduate colleges is to establish a complete system of integration of production and education, which is of great significance to the cultivation of talents. In reality, there are many serious shortcomings in the current production-education integration mechanism and school-enterprise cooperation of undergraduate colleges. Solving these problems requires the correct guidance of some institutions. From the government’s standpoint, some relevant laws and regulations are adopted to promote school-enterprise cooperation, so as to build a new mechanism of integration of production and education. This article expounds the necessity of constructing the integration of production and education, school-enterprise cooperation and the obstacles encountered in the construction process, and discusses the path of constructing a new mechanism.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Block Chain on Internet in the Context of Big Data and Its Future Prospect
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the rapid development of modern economy and Internet technology, the traditional financial industry has to better serve the needs of the times by developing Internet finance. As a new type of Internet technology, block chain, relying on the characteristics of decentralization, reliable data, collective maintenance and non-tampering, provides the possibility to accelerate the innovation of financial products and improve the efficiency of financial operation. The emergence of Internet finance is a very subversive new model, coupled with the upsurge of public participation, Internet finance has developed rapidly in a few short years. As a modern internet financial technology, blockchain technology, based on big data technology, can help Internet finance to solve credit problems, so as to effectively reduce financial risks. Blockchain technology provides better development opportunities for Internet finance. This paper mainly discusses the impact of blockchain on the Internet in the context of big data, and analyzes its future development.

articleTitle: Seeing the Development and Future from the Process of Communication
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the advancement of science and technology and the constant improvement of people's living standard, the network and communications industry have been closely linked with the people and inseparable from the normal operation of individuals' lives, offices and enterprises to large-scale national and even global information. It is enough to see that the communications industry with unlimited potential plays a decisive role in society. This paper focuses on how the communications industry is applied in various fields in the development process and forecasts the future direction of this important industry.

articleTitle: Study on Rural Planning Strategy of Urban Fringe under the Background of Ecological Constraints
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Urban fringe is not only the frontier area of urban development, but also the ecologically sensitive area, its rural transformation is unique. Taking Laoyu village in the urban fringe of Jinan City as an example, this paper expounds the planning strategy of rural transformation and reconstruction in the urban fringe under the background of strict ecological constraints, puts forward the rural planning path of "spatial planning-industry promotion -community building", through the planning measures of controlling ecological space, optimizing production space, improving living space and cooperating with rural community construction, to realize the optimal allocation of rural production factors, promote the endogenous power of rural sustainable development, and build a planning system responsive to rural transformation and development.

articleTitle: Report on Electromagnetic Field Theory and Waves
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Electromagnetic field theory is a crucial content in the field of electronic engineering, the practical proof of its theory also guides the beginners in the field. This paper focuses on experiments on capacitors, electric field strength and particle performance, magnetic field strength and particle performance, and radio waves and electromagnetic fields. These four online laboratory experiments explore capacitors, electric fields, magnetic fields, and EM waves, respectively. The purpose of this report is to convey the information compiled as a result of this work. The article accesses the online applet used from https://phet.colorado.edu/en/simulation of Physics Education Technology (PhET) and conducts experiments under the environment of installing Java script. Through experiments, the understanding and knowledge of related topics are effectively enhanced, thereby benefiting students. It verified the proportional relationship between stored charge, energy and capacitance, summarized the behavior of particles under electric and magnetic fields, and verified that high-frequency electrons produce short wavelengths, while strong electric fields cause strong forces applied to the electrons.

articleTitle: Analysis on Predicaments and Countermeasures of Rural Environment Management---a Case Study of "Three Great Revolutions" in Rural Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Advancing "three great revolutions" in rural environment is the important measure for deepening beautiful countryside construction. The research finds that in the course of advancing the policy, there exit several problems, such as multiple leadership, narrow profit margin in enterprises, high cost of management, insufficient supporting funds and inactive farmers. The paper proposes to enhance make plans in all aspects, strengthening overall supervision, emphasize operation management, widen financing approaches and expand propaganda to make the "three great revolutions" go smoothly.

articleTitle: Value Co-creation Mechanisms in Crowdsourcing Innovation
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As a new business model, crowdsourcing innovation is widely used for enterprises to complete innovation tasks by the external crowds. To achieve the multi-win goal, the enterprises, the external crowds and crowdsourcing platform make an alliance and co-create value. Based on the third-party platform crowdsourcing innovation model, this paper proposes that the essence of crowdsourcing innovation is the value co-creation of multi-agent participation. Based on grounded theory, this paper constructs the theoretical model of the realization mechanism of multi-agent participation value co-creation in crowdsourcing innovation from the three parties’ perspective. This research finds that the influencing factors of value co-creation include six factors: task attributes incentive mechanisms, trust mechanisms, platform supports, participation motivation and diversities. The process of value co-creation includes resource integration and interaction. The results of value co-creation include three elements: innovation value, knowledge value, and relationship value.

articleTitle: Construction and Application of BIM Engineering Technology Research Center
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Building model mainly refers to the three-dimensional model. It transforms the architectural drawing from two-dimensional plane graphics to three-dimensional spatial model, and further associates the information of building size, cost, progress, materials, quality, contract and management with the three-dimensional model, and forms a data-based multi-dimensional model tool for project management. It can share building information and improve the efficiency of project management. With the continuous development of building information model (BIM), the depth of its development and utilization in teaching gradually increases. The development and utilization of building information model for teachers, students and enterprises engaged in engineering teaching can promote the process of information construction industry in an all-round way. The establishment of BIM Engineering Technology Research Center provides stable technology, talents and funds for the informatization process of construction industry, and promotes the upgrading of construction industry.

articleTitle: Application of Machine Learning and Artificial Intelligence in Information Processing of Community E-Commerce -- A Case Study in 5G Environment
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the 5G era, with the continuous development of Internet technology and mobile Internet, the development of e-commerce websites has a rapid growth trend. Faced with the growing trend of community e-commerce, how to dig out useful information from mass data and rationalize the use of information processing is particularly critical. Among them, machine learning and artificial intelligence can effectively process the information of community e-commerce. In its community e-commerce, based on the connotation and algorithm of machine learning, the application and development of community e-commerce in the 5G era are summarized comprehensively, so as to efficiently process the information of community e-commerce and realize the development of community e-commerce.

articleTitle: A Review of Knowledge Graph Technology in the field of Automatic Question Answering
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The automatic question answering (QA) system is a typical natural language processing task. How to make the automatic question answering system more intelligent is a popular research direction in the field of natural language processing. In this era of information explosion, the multisource of data itself makes it difficult to integrate and manage. To solve such problems, it is particularly important to construct and present a complete knowledge system. The knowledge graph (KG) shows real-world knowledge through highly structured graphs. Based on the concept of KG, this paper introduces the classification and research status of KG, focuses on the application of knowledge graph in the field of automatic QA, explains the key technologies in the process of constructing knowledge graph, and finally shows the application of knowledge graph in other fields.

articleTitle: Emergency Evacuation Simulation Based on BIM Technology for Scientific Facility
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: BIM Technology is the mainstream direction of modern engineering construction development. This paper studies the emergency evacuation simulation method based on BIM Technology, which integrates the fire dynamic simulation, emergency evacuation, and BIM technologies. It carries out emergency evacuation simulation for the Optical Fiber Waveguide Center of laser fusion research center, CAEP. Optical Fiber Waveguide Center located in Chengdu industrial park is the first research building designed and managed by BIM Technology in laser fusion research center which serves for Shenguang high power laser facility at Mianyang. This research work finds out the technical route for developing and promoting the application of BIM Technology in safety production management for high power laser facility. It also gives important reference for the safety production and information management for large-scale scientific devices built by CAEP and helps the precise design for the future high power laser facility for China.

articleTitle: Government information sharing scheme for cross-departmental collaboration
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: "Internet plus government services" often involves cross-departmental information sharing, among which there are a lot of problems such as data security, data permissions and lack of motivative, these problems make it difficult to share data in the cross-departmental collaboration government businesses. To address this issue, the main mode and related technology application of the current government data sharing and exchange are analyzed, and a decentralized data sharing mode based on block chain technology is proposed. This government information sharing scheme for cross departmental collaboration combines smart contract and data sharding storage technology, it can effectively reduce the cost of cross-departmental data sharing, and has good performance and scalability.

articleTitle: Performance Evaluation of Stock Funds Based on Cluster Analysis and Factor Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Fund performance is an important basis for fund investment decisions. Foreign securities markets and securities investment funds developed relatively early, in the 1960s, researchers have put forward many indicators and models to evaluate fund performance from different angles and aspects, includes T-M model, H-M model, three factor model and improved four factor model. As the most mature country in the world, the United States has done a lot of empirical research on fund performance evaluation. Most of the studies show that the fund can not significantly overcome the market due to the influence of many factors such as stock selection ability and timing ability. On the basis of screening all kinds of international research results, combined with the actual situation of domestic fund market, this paper selects five indexes, including net return rate, sharp index, market risk, timing ability and stock selection ability, to establish the corresponding mathematical model, and uses the method of cluster analysis and factor analysis to evaluate the performance of fund, and the model is tested and analyzed. The experimental results show that the method proposed in this paper has good evaluation performance.

articleTitle: Study on the Effect of COVID-19 on Agricultural Industrialization Based on Big Data of Electrical Power
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Under the wake of COVID-19, agricultural production and people's consumption are seriously affected, in addition, the number of methods to quantitatively analyze of the degree of influence is limited. The big data of electrical power can accurately reflect the business situation of enterprises in the industry. This paper select hundreds of leading enterprises in agricultural industrialization as the analysis objects, and use Keyword Index Technology to construct the corresponding system of enterprise name-electric household number, and use Multilevel Coordination Algorithm to fit the electricity curve of leading enterprises in agricultural industrialization, to study the impact degree difference and resilience of the epidemic situation on the subdivision industry, and use Covariance Analysis Algorithm to analyze the correlation of subdivision industry under the epidemic situation, and to give the prospect of development opportunities in the period after the COVID-19 epidemic situation.

articleTitle: Overall Progress and Achievements of the Integration of Informatization and Industrialization in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In recent years, China’s implementation of the Integration of Informatization and Industrialization (III) has made a series of important progress in improving enterprise’s quality and performance, facilitating sector’s transformation and upgrading, and promoting coordinated development across regions. Based on the assessment data of China’s 150,000 enterprises from 31 provinces and more than 100 subsectors, this paper summarized and analyzed the progress and achievements of III in China from multiple perspectives such as country as a whole, regions, sectors and enterprises. Results show that the overall level of III in China has been improved steadily, with distribution structure evolving from "pyramid-shaped" to "spindle-shaped". Breakthroughs have been made in both vertical and horizontal integration of key sectors, and the imbalanced development among different types of enterprises has been reduced.

articleTitle: Analysis of the Impact of Marketing Strategies on Customer Loyalty in a B2C E-Commerce Environment - Mediated by Customer Perceived Value
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: With the gradual popularization of the Internet and the increasing demand for online shopping. How to enhance the competitiveness of B2C shopping platforms and gain customer loyalty has become the pursuit of all enterprise shopping platforms. Carry out six-dimensional analysis of marketing strategy, think analysis of customer perceived value, establish a conceptual model of the influence of marketing strategy on customer loyalty-take customer perceived value as an intermediary, put forward relevant influence analysis hypotheses, obtain research data through questionnaires, and use structural equation model carries out relevant path analysis, verifies relevant influential hypotheses, and verifies the direct and indirect influence of marketing strategies on customer loyalty.

articleTitle: Study on Civil Aviation Airport Franchise Contract Based on Simulation Analysis
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Aiming at the price competition and service competition between airport stores, based on a dual-channel supply chain competition model construct of an airport and a franchise store, by analyzing the impact of price and service competition on their sale decisions, this paper studies how to design the optimal franchise contract. Furthermore, a numerical simulation is given to illustrate the influence of different competitive intensity on their behaviors and the performance of the supply chain. The result shows that: 1. Franchise contract with uniform price can lead to a higher price and higher service level due to the elimination of price competition, while franchise contract with uniform service level can lead to a lower price and lower service level due to the elimination of service competition. 2. Compare to airport, franchise store can earn more sale revenue with the advantage of backwardness when the price competition is dominated. 3. Franchise contract with uniform price can lead to a higher performance of the supply chain when price competition is dominated, while uniform service level can lead to a higher performance of the supply chain when service competition is dominated.

articleTitle: Study on the strategy of multilateral electricity trading among provinces in Northeast China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Northeast China is an important birthplace of China's power market reform. The development of its power market trading mode is of great significance to the deepening and promotion of China's power market reform. Therefore, taking Northeast China as an example, this paper analyzed the characteristics of the current inter-provincial multilateral trading market, and explores the influencing factors of the scale of inter provincial multilateral trading in Northeast China. Combined with the characteristics of power grid structure and resource endowment in Northeast China, the calculation model of multilateral trade electricity in Northeast China is established. On this basis, taking the optimal economic benefits, resource allocation fairness and demand satisfaction index as the objectives, and taking the upper limit of trading volume and the balance of electricity and electricity as constraints, the paper puts forward a strategy suitable for multilateral electricity trading. Finally, the effectiveness of this strategy is verified with the actual data of Northeast China power market.

articleTitle: Measurement and Strategy of Urban Green Development Level in Hubei Yangtze River Economic Belt
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Establish a green development index system for counties (districts) in the Yangtze River Economic Belt of Hubei Province, explore the calculation method of green development level, and compare the green development level differences of 48 county-level districts in the Hubei Yangtze River Economic Belt to conclude: 1) The levels of green development in the cities and towns of the Yangtze River Economic Belt in Hubei Province are uneven and the polarization is serious; 2) Hubei Yangtze River Economic Belt has formed growth poles clustered by green development in Yichang, Wuhan and Huangshi; analyze the factors affecting the city’s green development index: the pros and cons of natural geographical conditions, the degree of convenient transportation, the size of the population density, and the reasonable industrial structure have a positive impact on the city’s green development index.

articleTitle: Research on The Construction of Sci-tech Innovation Ability Index and Spatial Difference Measurement
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The research on the ability of sci-tech innovation has always been a hot topic in the field of regional innovation. It is of great significance to promote the overall competitiveness of industry and the development of regional economy. Based on the comprehensive factors of science and technology support ability, innovation environment, innovation ability and its output, this paper studies the sci-tech innovation ability of Guangdong Province, constructs STICI for the first time, analyzes the actual data of 2018 of 21 regions in Guangdong Province, and measures the sci-tech innovation ability of each region. The difference of sci-tech innovation ability is also analyzed based on two levels of comprehensive ability and first level factor. It is concluded that the development of regional sci-tech innovation is unbalanced in different regions in Guangdong Province. It is suggested that the regional sci-tech innovation ability can be improved and the coordinated development of the whole province can be promoted through policy guidance, precise assistance, cooperation and co-construction, and strengthened dominant position of enterprises in sci-tech innovation in eastern and western regions of Guangdong Province.

articleTitle: The Impact of Economic Policy Uncertainty on China’s Regional Economy and Its Dynamic Effects —A theoretical analysis based on TVP-FAVAR
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Through a review of prior literature, we can conclude that average consumption in developed regions is generally lower than less developed regions and the economic policy uncertainty (EPU) has differently negative effects on China’s investment, consumption, price levels, and output in the short term. This paper intends to divide further China’s provinces and cities into consumption-led areas, moderate areas, and investment-led areas. Then this paper adopts the time-varying parameter factor-augmented vector autoregression (TVP-FAVAR) model to conduct a theoretical analysis of macroeconomic response under China’s economic policy uncertainty. Using the transmission mechanism of interest rate channel, credit channel, and exchange rate channel, we predict that the increase in policy uncertainty will have a more significant negative impact on regions with a low proportion of consumption, manifested in a higher degree of decline in consumption, investment, and output. However, the price level is significantly consistent across regions. As for the nonlinear issue, as China’s economic environment changes, major economic indicators in various regions have shown obvious time-varying characteristics.

articleTitle: The Impact of Air Route Subsidies on Airport Economy Based on Chengdu’s “Two Airports in a City” Mode
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: The construction of second airport will help Chengdu to transform from a "domestic transportation hub" to an "international regional transportation hub", hence to leading the development of airport economy, and it is important to study the development strategy of airport economy under Chengdu's "two airports in one city" mode. This paper considers the price competition of two homogeneous air routes under the "two airports in one city" mode. Based on the Bertrand model, the competitive relationship of homogeneous air routes is constructed. Under Nash equilibrium, the optimized competition decisions of the two homogeneous air routes are solved. Hence, studies the influence of government behavior on the development of airport economy based on air routes competition. The results shows that the ticket price is positively correlated with the original demand of the two airports and negatively correlated with government subsidies. The development of airport economy is positively correlated with the government subsidies. However, when the development of airport economy is lower than a certain level, the air routes’ subsidies will decline government’s tax income, in this case, the government's optimal decision is not to subsidize.

articleTitle: Media Big Data Cyber Infrastructure for Epidemic Prevention and Emergency Response
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: Big data in the media is facing many challenges with huge volume, rapid increase, and a wide variety. Moreover, in the context of the global coronavirus epidemic prevention and control, media big data has different characteristics and missions. The scientific data platform, tool integration, scientific research process and international cooperation proposed in this article are implemented in four main lines of international cooperation for the implementation of ideas and technical methods in the field of media big data science for epidemic prevention and emergency, to achieve effective data management and analysis to improve the efficiency of scientific discovery. For cyber infrastructure research, preliminary research needs to build a digital, data-based, and intelligent cyber infrastructure framework and emergency response measures for disease prevention, psychological comfort, and material security. Based on the concept of "Data-Method-Model-System-Standard", the research overall design framework of MEP (media big data for epidemic prevention) is generated, and the research results are intended to help the epidemic prevention ecological layout of the media big data. An integrated basic information platform has been established globally.

articleTitle: Cultivating marine big data and information industry around supercomputing project --Based on the analysis of Shandong Province
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: As a major province of marine economy and marine science and technology, Shandong has always attached great importance to the development of the marine industry, and has made remarkable and outstanding achievements in recent years, but there is still a certain gap between the goal of building a strong marine province. This paper investigated and analyzed how did supercomputing technology promote the development of ocean big data and information industry in Shandong Province. Finally, according to the problems facing today, we proposed corresponding strategies with a view to providing a valuable reference for relevant departments in making scientific decisions.

articleTitle: Research on the Evaluation of Core Competitiveness of Full-service Airlines in China
publicationTitle: 2020 International Signal Processing, Communications and Engineering Management Conference (ISPCEM)
abstract: In the increasingly competitive aviation transport market, full-service carriers, which occupy the dominant position in the market, are facing many development bottlenecks, such as the surge in operating costs and the decline in service standards. Therefore, it is necessary to comprehensively analyze the key competitive factors that affect the development of enterprises from the perspective of core competitiveness, so as to guide enterprises to rationally allocate resources and improve its comprehensive strength. Through the construction of the evaluation index system of the core competitiveness of all service airlines, the fractal theoretical model with more scientific, practical and application prospects is studied and used to evaluate the core competitiveness of 10 full-service airlines in China in 2018. Model analysis proves that among the four major airlines, China Southern Airlines and Air China have the strongest core competitiveness. In terms of sub-dimension competitiveness, some small and medium aviation companies have shown excellent market competitiveness.
